description: This is a test class for the CandidateDao component within the recruitment data access layer of the OrangeHRM project. It contains unit tests for methods related to candidate data operations, including saving candidates, retrieving candidate details, filtering candidate lists, and managing candidate history.

classes.name: CandidateDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing CandidateDao functionalities related to recruitment candidates in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of CandidateDao, and populates test data from a YAML fixture.

methods.name: testSaveCandidate
methods.description: Tests saving a new candidate and verifies the returned object is correct.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Tests saving a candidate vacancy and verifies the associations and vacancy name.

methods.name: testGetCandidateById
methods.description: Retrieves a candidate by ID and asserts the correctness of fetched data, including handling of non-existent IDs.

methods.name: testGetCandidateVacancyByCandidateId
methods.description: Fetches a candidate vacancy record by candidate ID and verifies associations.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidates
methods.description: Deletes candidates and checks that the candidates are removed from the database.

methods.name: testDeleteCandidateVacancy
methods.description: Deletes a candidate vacancy record and confirms its removal.

methods.name: testGetCandidateList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of candidates with default filters and verifies list contents and candidate details.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByCandidateId
methods.description: Filters candidates by candidate ID and verifies results.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByJobTitleId
methods.description: Filters candidates by job title ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByHiringMangerId
methods.description: Filters candidates by hiring manager ID.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByKeywords
methods.description: Filters candidates based on keywords in their profile.

methods.name: testGetCandidateListFilterByMethodOfApplication
methods.description: Filters candidates by method of application.

methods.name: testSaveCandidateHistory
methods.description: Creates and saves a candidate history record, verifying its properties.
